scenario_description:
Objective: Complete tonight’s voice-care humidifier wick swap so the bedroom unit can be set up before the dry-air school week.
Emerging Need: The swap begins, then stops when the delivered wick will not seat and the old wick tears apart, leaving the opened unit unusable.
Decision Context: Saved voice-care supply guidance identifies the compatible unscented wick and rules out running the unit without one; current notices define a short local hold window.
Consequence: Once that hold window closes, the interrupted setup cannot be finished tonight rather than merely waiting for routine replenishment.

parameter.title: Replace voice humidifier wick
parameter.content: Swap the bedroom voice humidifier wick before setting up the unit for tonight.

parameter.subject: Delivery completed: humidifier replacement wick
parameter.body: Your universal humidifier replacement wick was delivered to the front stoop at 9:12 AM. Order note: one universal cut-to-fit evaporative wick, household humidifier aisle.

parameter.content: I just opened the bedroom humidifier for the wick swap. The delivered universal wick bows up and will not seat, and the old wick tore apart when I pulled it. The tray is rinsed but the unit is sitting open, so I stopped the setup.

parameter.subject: Stock alert: HCM-350 compatible wick available tonight
parameter.body: Your stock alert is active: Hamilton Hardware has one unscented HCM-350 compatible humidifier wick at the Canton counter. We can place a no-cost same-day hold if we receive a reply by 7:35 PM. Pickup is available until 8:10 PM; the counter is closed Monday and Tuesday for year-end inventory.

parameter.subject: Stock alert closed: HCM-350 compatible wick
parameter.body: The 7:35 PM same-day hold queue has closed. Remaining HCM-350 compatible wicks have been moved into prepaid pickup batches, and the public counter will not reopen until December 30.
